skill.name: knowledge-work-finance
skill.description: Use when you need finance and accounting workflows — journal entries, reconciliation, financial statements, variance analysis, and month-end close support.
whenToUse: Preparing journal entries — accruals, prepaids, fixed assets, payroll, revenue with debits/credits
Reconciling GL balances against subledger, bank, or third-party balances
Generating income statements with period-over-period comparison and flux analysis
Running SOX 404 control testing — sample selection, workpapers, deficiency classification

keyConcepts.explanation: JE preparation best practices — standard accrual types, supporting documentation requirements, and review workflows, with proper debits and credits.
Methodology for GL-to-subledger, bank recs, and intercompany, including reconciling-item categorization and aging.
Variance decomposition (price/volume, rate/mix) into drivers with materiality thresholds, narrative explanations, and waterfall charts.
Month-end close checklist with task sequencing, dependencies, status tracking, and common close activities by day.
Income statement, balance sheet, and cash flow formats with GAAP presentation and flux-analysis methodology.
SOX 404 control-testing methodology — sample selection, documentation standards, and deficiency classification.

gotchas: Primarily designed for Cowork, Anthropic's agentic desktop app, though it also runs in Claude Code
Does not provide financial, tax, or audit advice — all outputs must be reviewed by qualified professionals before use
Works best connected to ERP and data-warehouse MCP servers; without them you must paste or upload data
Commands take structured arguments like '/journal-entry ap-accrual 2024-12', not just free text
Month-end close is a sequenced flow — entries, then recs, then statements — so running steps out of order breaks dependencies
